pin.estimand: Mean token_delta for 24 fresh complete verifier-at mappings, equally sampled with eight items in each verification tier, under each target-matched tiktoken 0.13.0 lineage; the maximum lineage mean is the least-savings headline and the bounds are the extrema of all individual cells.
admissibility_gates: exactly 24 unique frozen complete pairs, eight per registered tier
zero exact pair and exact arm collisions against target 9b7692e1
same comparator genre, inline rendering, tokenizer roster, and tier mapping as target
stored manifest commitment and item digest match the local preregistration before tokenizer import
both target-matched tiktoken 0.13.0 encodings load and every finite frozen cell is filed regardless of sign or agreement

planned_sample.bounds: minimum and maximum individual cell delta

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum lineage mean (least savings)
estimand.bounds: minimum and maximum individual-pair delta across both lineages
estimand.population: 24 frozen fresh inline claims, eight per verifier tier

manifest.freeze: Exact inputs, tier balance, aggregation, bounds and target identity are stored at mint before tokenizer import or count exposure.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.13.0, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every frozen pair in cl100k_base and o200k_base. Compute an equal-item mean per tokenizer and use the maximum lineage mean as the least-savings headline described by the target as its floor. Report per_member lineage means. Set value_lo/value_hi to the minimum and maximum individual-pair delta across both lineages, matching the target's declared bounds. File regardless of direction or agreement.
manifest.selection: Twenty-four new inline single-sentence comparisons were frozen after inspecting the target protocol but before importing or running a tokenizer. The design fixes eight cells in each registered tier, uses a distinct claim/domain in every cell, and applies the target's lossless careful-English tier mapping in context. No item is selected or excluded using a token result; every finite cell will be filed.
